nodes.title: SG-7 · Build worker execution engine
nodes.body:
Context: the repository has a Go backend (backend/internal/round, execution, gitrepo) but no worker module; the top level holds backend/, game/ and context.md. Desired behavior: a new Go module in worker/ provides config loading, structured logging, a file-based per-World lock, JSON execution records, startup recovery, Git-polled Round detection with expiry closing and snapshot freezing, isolated worktree executions with timeout, retry, budget and an approval gate, a coding-agent provider interface with mock and Claude Code CLI adapters, and structured reports. Expected result: every behavior is covered by unit tests with mocked Git, provider and clock. Why: the Worker must survive restarts and never publish unreviewed or partially built work.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a worker YAML file, when config is loaded, then values and defaults are returned and invalid values are rejected, and a JSON slog logger is available
- Given one World lock held, when a second execution tries to acquire it, then it fails with ErrLocked; after release it succeeds
- Given RUNNING or QUEUED execution records at startup, when recovery runs, then each is resumed (QUEUED) or marked RECOVERING and stale locks are released
- Given OPEN and SCHEDULED Rounds from the mocked Git interface, when polling at a fake time past EndsAt, then the expired Round is closed with an immutable snapshot.yaml whose format matches backend round.Snapshot
- Given an execution, when it runs, then it uses an isolated worktree, honors timeout, retries up to the limit, stops at the budget, and blocks at AWAITING_APPROVAL until approved
- Given the mock provider and Claude CLI adapter, when run, then the adapter passes community text as data over stdin with an argument slice (no shell) and restricted permissions, and structured reports are written under development/executions


## Scope
- In scope: worker/ Go module with internal packages config, logging, lock, state, recovery, rounds, runner, provider
- Out of scope: Analyzer/planner/publisher/next-round pipeline stages
- Out of scope: backend and game changes
- Out of scope: Real network, Git remotes or Claude invocation in tests
- Preserve: backend module and its round.yaml, snapshot.yaml and execution YAML formats


## Technical constraints
- Go 1.22, gopkg.in/yaml.v3 only external dependency, no database or queue
- Community text must never be shell-interpolated or used as system instructions


## Dependencies
- backend/internal/round/snapshot.go snapshot format
- backend/internal/gitrepo Committer semantics


## Definition of done
- All requirements have Act and Verify units merged
- go test ./... passes in worker/


## Non-functional requirements
- Atomic file writes for state and reports


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Worker loads config, logs structured JSON and enforces a per-World file lock
nodes.body:
Context: no worker module exists. Desired behavior: config.LoadFS reads a worker YAML (world, repo_path, work_root, poll_interval, exec_timeout, max_retries, max_budget_usd, auto_publish, provider) with defaults and validation, logging.New builds a JSON slog logger, and lock.Acquire gives one development execution per World. Expected result: a second acquire fails until release. Why: prevents concurrent executions on one World.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a YAML missing optional fields, when loaded, then defaults apply (poll_interval 30s, exec_timeout 30m, max_retries 2, auto_publish false)
- Given an empty world, non-positive timeout or negative budget, when loaded, then an error names the field
- Given a held lock for a World, when Acquire is called again, then ErrLocked is returned
- Given a released lock, when Acquire is called, then it succeeds and the lock file contains the owner


## Scope
- In scope: worker/go.mod
- In scope: worker/internal/config
- In scope: worker/internal/logging
- In scope: worker/internal/lock
- Out of scope: Recovery of stale locks
- Preserve: backend config style (LoadFS, yaml.v3)


## Technical constraints
- Lock via os.OpenFile O_CREATE|O_EXCL, no flock dependency


## Definition of done
- Config, logger and lock packages compile and behave as specified


## Non-functional requirements
- Lock file removal only by its owner


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Executions persist as JSON records and startup recovery resumes or marks unfinished ones
nodes.body:
Context: backend execution records are YAML; the worker keeps its own local JSON state. Desired behavior: state.Store saves and loads one JSON file per execution atomically; recovery.Run scans for unfinished executions and releases stale locks. Expected result: after a crash nothing is assumed to be running. Why: the Worker is not continuously running.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a saved Execution, when loaded, then all fields round-trip
- Given a RUNNING execution with Attempt below max retries, when recovery runs, then it becomes QUEUED (resumed) with an Error note
- Given a RUNNING execution with Attempt at max retries, when recovery runs, then it becomes RECOVERING
- Given a stale lock owned by a dead process, when recovery runs, then the lock is removed; AWAITING_APPROVAL and COMPLETED records are untouched


## Scope
- In scope: worker/internal/state
- In scope: worker/internal/recovery
- Out of scope: Running the executions
- Preserve: Status names from backend execution package


## Technical constraints
- Atomic write via temp file and rename; clock and process-liveness injected


## Dependencies
- R1 lock package


## Definition of done
- Store and recovery behave as specified


## Non-functional requirements
- Safe IDs only (no path traversal)


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Worker detects scheduled and closed Rounds via a Git interface and closes expired Rounds with an immutable snapshot
nodes.body:
Context: backend round.Service.Close writes snapshot.yaml (Snapshot/SnapshotEntry, mode 0444, never overwritten), records HEAD as freeze_commit and moves to CLOSED. Desired behavior: rounds.Poller pulls through a Git interface, lists worlds/<world>/rounds/*/round.yaml, reports SCHEDULED and CLOSED Rounds and closes OPEN Rounds whose EndsAt is not after the injected clock. Expected result: identical snapshot contract. Why: the Worker must close Rounds even when the backend is down.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given Rounds in SCHEDULED, OPEN and CLOSED status, when Detect runs, then scheduled and closed lists are returned
- Given an OPEN Round with EndsAt <= fake now, when CloseExpired runs, then snapshot.yaml exists with mode 0444, Git Commit and Head are called, and round.yaml has status CLOSED, freeze_commit and closed_at
- Given an existing snapshot.yaml, when CloseExpired runs, then it is not overwritten and an error is returned
- Given an OPEN Round not yet expired, when CloseExpired runs, then nothing changes


## Scope
- In scope: worker/internal/rounds
- Out of scope: Git CLI implementation details beyond the interface
- Preserve: Backend snapshot.yaml field names: round, world, frozen_at, contributions[id, player, created_at, prompt_sha256]


## Technical constraints
- Git interface: Pull, Commit, Head, Contributions; clock injected


## Dependencies
- R1


## Definition of done
- Poller and closer implemented per contract


## Non-functional requirements
- Path segments sanitized


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Executions run in an isolated worktree with timeout, retry, budget, approval gate and structured reports
nodes.body:
Context: builds on lock and state packages. Desired behavior: runner.Runner.Run acquires the World lock, creates a worktree through a Worktrees interface, calls an Agent per attempt under a context timeout, retries failures up to MaxRetries, stops when cumulative cost reaches MaxBudgetUSD, then sets AWAITING_APPROVAL; Publish refuses until the record is APPROVED unless auto_publish. A report JSON is written to development/executions/<id>.report.json. Why: safe, bounded, supervised development.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the lock is already held, when Run is called, then it returns lock.ErrLocked and no worktree is created
- Given an agent that blocks past ExecTimeout on the fake clock-driven context, when Run runs, then the attempt fails with a timeout error and is retried
- Given an agent failing every time, when Run runs with MaxRetries 2, then exactly 3 attempts are made and the record is FAILED
- Given attempts whose cost reaches MaxBudgetUSD, when Run runs, then ErrBudgetExceeded is returned and no further attempt starts
- Given a successful attempt, when Run ends, then status is AWAITING_APPROVAL and Publish returns ErrNotApproved until approved; the worktree is always removed
- Given any outcome, then a structured report with attempts, cost, status and error exists under development/executions


## Scope
- In scope: worker/internal/runner
- Out of scope: Real Git worktree CLI
- Out of scope: Publishing artifacts
- Preserve: state.Execution fields
- Preserve: lock API


## Technical constraints
- Agent interface: Run(ctx, workDir, prompt string) (costUSD float64, output string, err error); Worktrees interface: Add(ctx, path, branch, baseRef) error and Remove(ctx, path) error


## Dependencies
- R1
- R2


## Definition of done
- Runner behaves per criteria


## Non-functional requirements
- Worktree removal runs on a non-cancelled context


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Coding agent providers: mock and Claude Code CLI adapter with restricted permissions and no shell interpolation
nodes.body:
Context: community text is untrusted. Desired behavior: provider.Provider has Run(ctx, workDir, prompt) (cost, output, err); Mock returns a deterministic result and is flagged as mock; Claude builds an argument slice for the configured command with restricted permission flags, runs it with Dir=workDir through an injected Exec function, and sends the structured prompt on stdin, never in a shell string. Why: safe coding-agent invocation.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the mock provider, when Run is called, then it returns its configured cost and output and Mock() is true
- Given the Claude adapter, when Run is called with a prompt containing shell metacharacters, then the argument slice contains no prompt text and the prompt is passed on stdin
- Given the Claude adapter, then args include print mode and an explicit allowed-tools list excluding Bash and the working directory equals workDir
- Given the command fails or ctx is cancelled, then Run returns an error wrapping the cause


## Scope
- In scope: worker/internal/provider
- Out of scope: Running the real Claude binary in tests
- Preserve: Agent signature used by runner


## Technical constraints
- exec.CommandContext with an argument slice; never sh -c


## Definition of done
- Providers satisfy the runner Agent signature


## Non-functional requirements
- Stdout capture bounded to 1 MiB


## Clarifying questions
- None

module github.com/worldseed/storyforge/worker

go 1.22

require gopkg.in/yaml.v3 v3.0.1
steps.expected: go build ./... resolves yaml.v3 without network

steps.action: Define Config{World, RepoPath, WorkRoot string; PollInterval, ExecTimeout time.Duration; MaxRetries int; MaxBudgetUSD float64; AutoPublish bool; LogLevel string; Provider ProviderConfig{Kind, Command string; Args []string}} with yaml tags world, repo_path, work_root, poll_interval, exec_timeout, max_retries, max_budget_usd, auto_publish, log_level, provider. LoadFS(fsys fs.FS, name string) (Config, error) reads and yaml.Unmarshals, applies defaults when zero (PollInterval 30s, ExecTimeout 30m, MaxRetries 2, MaxBudgetUSD 5, LogLevel info, Provider.Kind mock) and returns fmt.Errorf naming the field when World or RepoPath or WorkRoot is empty, ExecTimeout or PollInterval is negative, MaxRetries or MaxBudgetUSD is negative

steps.action: Add New(level string, w io.Writer) *slog.Logger that maps debug|info|warn|error (default info) to slog.Level and returns slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(w, &slog.HandlerOptions{Level: lvl}))

steps.action: Add ErrLocked = errors.New("lock: held"). Acquire(path, owner string) (*Lock, error) does MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path)), os.OpenFile(path, O_CREATE|O_EXCL|O_WRONLY, 0o644), returns ErrLocked on fs.ErrExist, writes owner into the file. (*Lock).Release() reads the file and removes it only if its content equals the owner, returning nil when already gone; add Owner(path) (string, error) reading the owner
steps.expected: Second Acquire returns ErrLocked; after Release Acquire succeeds

steps.symbol: new: Execution, Store, Save, Load, List
steps.action: Define Status constants QUEUED, RUNNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, FAILED, COMPLETED, RECOVERING. Execution{ID, World, Round string; Status Status; Attempt int; CostUSD float64; Error string; StartedAt, UpdatedAt time.Time} with json tags. Store{Dir string; Now func() time.Time}. Save sets UpdatedAt=Now(), validates ID with a regexp ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (no '..'), marshals indented JSON and writes via CreateTemp+Rename in Dir. Load(id) returns fs.ErrNotExist-wrapping error when missing. List returns every *.json sorted by ID, ignoring *.report.json
steps.expected: Round trip preserves all fields; unsafe ID returns an error

steps.action: Options{Store *state.Store; LockPath string; MaxRetries int; Alive func(pid int) bool; Log *slog.Logger}. Run(ctx) ([]Result, error): if LockPath exists and lock.Owner content is 'pid:<n>' with Alive(n) false, os.Remove it. For each List() execution with Status RUNNING or QUEUED: if Attempt < MaxRetries set Status QUEUED and Error 'resumed after restart' else set Status RECOVERING and Error 'interrupted; attempts exhausted'; Save; append Result{ID, Action resumed|marked}. Log each at Info. Leave other statuses unchanged
steps.code: type Result struct{ ID, Action string }
steps.expected: Results list one entry per unfinished execution

steps.action: Define Git interface{Pull(ctx) error; Commit(ctx, paths []string, msg string) error; Head(ctx) (string, error); Contributions(ctx, world, round string) ([]Contribution, error)} and Contribution{ID, Player, Prompt string; CreatedAt time.Time}. CloseExpired(ctx) ([]string, error): after Pull, for each OPEN Round with !Now().Before(EndsAt): list Git.Contributions, build entries with sha256 hex of Prompt, writeSnapshot, Git.Commit the snapshot path, on commit error remove the snapshot, then Head(), set FreezeCommit, ClosedAt=&frozenAt, Status CLOSED, rewrite round.yaml atomically and Commit it; return closed IDs

nodes.description: Implement orchestration in worker/internal/runner using the lock and state packages.
acceptance_criteria: Run enforces lock, timeout, retries, budget and approval gate
Reports are written atomically

steps.action: Report{ExecutionID, World, Round, Status string; Attempts int; CostUSD float64; Error string; StartedAt, FinishedAt time.Time; Mock bool} with json tags. WriteReport(repoRoot string, r Report) writes development/executions/<id>.report.json atomically (CreateTemp+Rename), validating ExecutionID like state.Store
steps.expected: Report file exists as indented JSON

steps.action: Define interfaces Agent and Worktrees as in the requirement and Runner{Cfg config.Config; Store *state.Store; Agent Agent; Trees Worktrees; LockPath, Prompt string; Now func() time.Time}. Run(ctx, exec state.Execution) error: lock.Acquire(LockPath, 'pid:<os.Getpid()>') (return ErrLocked as-is), defer Release; Trees.Add(ctx, filepath.Join(Cfg.WorkRoot,'worktrees',exec.ID), 'dev/'+exec.ID, 'HEAD') and defer Trees.Remove with context.WithoutCancel(ctx); set RUNNING and Save; loop attempt 0..Cfg.MaxRetries: if exec.CostUSD >= Cfg.MaxBudgetUSD return ErrBudgetExceeded after marking FAILED; actx,cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, Cfg.ExecTimeout); cost,_,err := Agent.Run(actx, worktreePath, Prompt); add cost to exec.CostUSD; map actx.Err()==DeadlineExceeded to ErrTimeout; Attempt++ and Save; on success set AWAITING_APPROVAL (or APPROVED when Cfg.AutoPublish) and break; on exhausting attempts set FAILED with Error. Always WriteReport (Mock from Cfg.Provider.Kind=='mock')
steps.expected: Run follows the lifecycle and reports each outcome

steps.action: Add sentinel errors and (r *Runner) Publish(ctx, id string, publish func(ctx context.Context) error) error that Loads the record, returns ErrNotApproved unless Status is APPROVED, otherwise calls publish and sets COMPLETED
steps.expected: Publish never runs the callback for unapproved executions
